title: IAL InLab
line: An innovation platform made more reliable.
problem: IAL InLab is a platform that supports innovation initiatives within the Institute for Adult Learning (IAL). Some parts of the platform would break whenever certain content fields were left empty in Storyblok CMS.
did: As a Frontend Developer, I worked with the project managers to find and fix functional bugs across the platform. One key fix used the nullish coalescing operator (??) to give content fields safe fallback values, so the interface handles empty values from Storyblok CMS without breaking.
outcome: A more reliable platform for both visitors and the content team, with pages that keep working even when a content field is left empty.

story.title: Situation
story.body: IAL InLab is a platform that supports innovation initiatives within the Institute for Adult Learning (IAL). Some parts of the platform would break whenever certain content fields were left empty in Storyblok CMS.

story.title: Task
story.body: As a Frontend Developer at Amber Creative, I worked with the project managers to find and fix the functional bugs across the platform.

story.title: Action
story.body: Together with the project managers, I identified the functional bugs across the platform and fixed them. One key fix was for the content fields that could come back empty from the CMS: I used the nullish coalescing operator (??) to give them safe fallback values, so the interface handles empty values without breaking.

story.title: Result
story.body: A more reliable platform for both visitors and the content team, with pages that keep working even when a content field is left empty.

notes: Written with STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result).
